blocks.text: 1 Samuel 14 contains 52 verses. It opens with: Now it fell upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armor, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison, that is on yonder side. But he told not his father. It concludes with: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any mighty man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: First Samuel moves from Eli's failing priestly house through Samuel's prophetic leadership and Saul's rejected kingship to David's anointing, rise, exile, and Saul's death.
